headline: Bitcoin dropped to its lowest level since August late on Sunday before bouncing back above $75,000, as more than $1 billion of leveraged bets were wiped out and customers kept pulling funds from Binance after its record hack.

market.asOf: BTC and ETH read from CoinGecko at about 04:00 UTC Mon 9 Nov (11:00 Bangkok), SOL at about 04:30 UTC. ETH sources disagree: CoinMarketCap showed $2,230 and -0.04% at the same time. Use the live prices on this page.
market.fearGreed: Fear: the alternative.me Crypto Fear & Greed Index read 28 (Fear), up from 25 (Extreme Fear) the day before. CoinMarketCap's own Fear & Greed index showed 32/100.

stories.title: Bitcoin hits its lowest since August in a Sunday-night drop, then bounces
stories.summary: Late on Sunday (US time) bitcoin fell to about $73,761, its lowest since August, per CoinDesk, then climbed back above $75,000. Reuters put the low at $73,708. More than $1 billion of leveraged trades were forcibly closed in 24 hours, most of them bets on higher prices. CoinDesk linked the drop to a scandal at Nvidia and stalled US-Iran talks; Reuters also pointed to worries that the new Democrat-controlled Congress will tighten crypto rules.
points: Of the more than $1B liquidated, $913M was long (bullish) positions; ether liquidations ($448M) were about twice bitcoin's ($272M), per CoinGlass data cited by CoinDesk.

Nvidia's board opened an independent probe into reports about CEO Jensen Huang; Nvidia says there is no sign secrets were compromised, per CoinDesk. Secretary of State Rubio said Iran talks had stalled.
US spot bitcoin ETFs lost about $1.28B last week, the worst week since June, turning 2026 year-to-date flows negative at about -$914M, per The Block.
CoinDesk names about $73,150 (the 200-day average) and about $77,430 (the 100-day average) as the levels traders watch, and says the bounce depends on how US stocks open on Monday.

stories.title: Binance hack fallout: withdrawals reopen, but customers keep pulling funds
stories.summary: Binance re-enabled HYPE and APT withdrawals on Sunday, ahead of its target, while INJ, Plasma, NEAR and LTC are due by the end of next week, per Bitcoin.com News. CryptoQuant data shows Binance's reserves have shrunk sharply since the 29 Oct hack, though the latest daily outflows are slowing. Elliptic, which puts the theft at $6.4B, says about $2.85B has been frozen or seized.
points: Since the hack Binance's BTC reserves are down about 56,000 BTC (7.7%) and its ETH reserves about 400,000 ETH (11.5%), per CryptoQuant via Bitcoin.com News.
ETH-based stablecoins on Binance are down about $9B (22%) to about $32B, per the same data.
Elliptic says about $175M of stolen funds has been turned into about 2,300 BTC, largely through THORChain, and about $3.13B still sits in addresses linked to the theft.
CFO Kaiser Ng has left and Justin Yek replaces him; the FBI attributes the attack to North Korea's TraderTraitor group, per The Block.
Binance has told French users their accounts will close on 31 December, per Cointelegraph.

sources.label: Bitcoin.com News: Binance restores HYPE, APT as reserve outflows mount

The Block: Binance CFO steps down

stories.title: MEXC sees $126M of outflows as the US moves to cut it off from American banks
stories.summary: The US Treasury's FinCEN ordered US financial institutions to stop processing transfers involving MEXC Global, saying it facilitated at least $16B of illicit transactions linked to Iran, North Korea, Russia and cybercrime. The order takes effect 30 days after it is published in the Federal Register. MEXC saw about $126M of net outflows in 24 hours, per DefiLlama data cited by CryptoSlate.
points: MEXC still holds about $4.35B in tracked assets, per DefiLlama via CryptoSlate.
MEXC says operations are normal and funds are secure, and has started an independent anti-money-laundering review; its CEO says the order does not freeze or seize assets, per CryptoSlate.
Users report Binance, OKX and Gate holding deposits that came from MEXC for compliance checks; no exchange-wide block is confirmed, per Blockonomi.
About $1.5B of the activity is tied to Russian sanctions evasion, per Treasury.

briefs.title: Democrats plan a broader crypto market-structure bill
briefs.summary: After sweeping the midterms, House Democrats reportedly plan a broader crypto bill that would give the SEC more power and limit the CFTC; Stand With Crypto's endorsed candidates went 27 won, 12 lost, per Decrypt.

briefs.title: Crypto in 401(k)s moves a step closer
briefs.summary: The Labor Department sent a proposed rule opening 401(k) plans to crypto and other alternative assets to the White House for review, per The Block.

briefs.title: Gnosis Pay card system breached
briefs.summary: Gnosis Pay found unauthorized access to the legacy system behind its consumer cards on 3 Nov; customer data was exposed but not funds, per Decrypt.

briefs.title: US sanctions 45 more targets tied to Prince Group
briefs.summary: Treasury added 45 targets linked to the Cambodia-based scam network; the US is seeking forfeiture of about $14B in bitcoin tied to the group, per Decrypt.

briefs.title: Ex-FBI agent pleads guilty to crypto theft
briefs.summary: A former FBI agent admitted stealing about $2.47M in crypto using wallet credentials from 35 FBI investigations, per The Block.

briefs.title: Vitalik: value ETH as a store of value, not a fee-burner
briefs.summary: Buterin says ETH should be valued as a store of value rather than a fee-burning token, per The Block.

briefs.title: China's factory-gate prices rise faster than expected
briefs.summary: China's October producer prices rose 5.7% on the year against a 5.3% forecast, while consumer prices rose 0.7% against 0.8% expected, per Discovery Alert.

calendar.note: Actual: CPI +0.7% on the year (consensus +0.8%, September +0.9%); PPI +5.7% (consensus +5.3%, September +5.0%), per Discovery Alert.
